content: गणः [गण् कर्मणि कर्तरि वा अच्] .²1 A flock, multitude, group, troop, collection; गुणिगणगणना, भगणः .²2 A series, a class. .²3 A body of followers or attendants. .²4 Particularly, a troop of demigods considered as Śivaʼs attendants and under the special superintendence of Gaṇeśa, a demigod of this troop; गणानां त्वा गणपतिं हवामहे कविं कवीनाम् <ab>&c.</ab>; गणा नमेरुप्रसवावतंसाः <ls>Ku. 1. 55</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">7. 40</ls>, <ls n="Ku. 7.">71</ls>; <ls>Me. 35</ls>, <ls n="Me.">57</ls>; <ls>Ki. 5. 13</ls>. .²5 Any assemblage or society of men formed for the attainment of the same objects. .²6 A company, association. .²7 A tribe, class. .²8 A series of lunar mansions classed under three heads (of god, men and demons). .²9 A sect (in philosophy, religion). .²10 A small body of troops (a sub-division of अक्षौहिणी), consisting of 27 chariots, as many elephants, 81 horses and 135 foot; <ls>Mb. 1. 2. 21</ls>. .²11 A number (in <ab>math.</ab>). .²12 A foot (in prosody). .²13 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) A series of roots or words belonging to the same rule and called after the first word of that series; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} भ्वादिगण {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} the class of roots which begin with भू. .²14 An epithet of Gaṇeśa.
